summary.intent: Fix a failing CI lint job caused by a version conflict between the `packageManager` field in `package.json` and the `version` input in GitHub Actions workflow files using `pnpm/action-setup@v6`.
summary.outcome: Removed `with: version: 10` blocks from all 6 affected workflow files (18 occurrences total), allowing `pnpm/action-setup@v6` to read the pnpm version exclusively from `packageManager: "pnpm@10.33.0"` in `package.json`. Changes were committed and pushed.

repo: The repo uses pnpm@10.33.0 declared via the `packageManager` field in package.json, which is the single source of truth for the pnpm version.
7 workflow files use `pnpm/action-setup@v6`: ci.yml, deploy-staging.yml, desktop-e2e.yml, desktop-release.yml, load-test.yml, web-e2e.yml, and at least one reusable workflow caller inside ci.yml.
ci.yml contains both standard job definitions and a reusable workflow call section with different indentation, requiring separate edit passes.

code.finding: A reusable workflow call block uses a different indentation level than the standard job definitions in the same file, requiring a separate edit to remove the `with: version: 10` block.

workflow: `pnpm/action-setup@v6` changed behavior to reject having both a `version` input in workflow YAML and a `packageManager` field in package.json — only one source of truth is allowed.

When a tool upgrade changes validation rules (rejecting previously valid dual-configuration), the fix is to consolidate to the canonical source (`packageManager` in package.json) and remove the redundant override in CI YAML.
Edit tools require reading a file before editing — attempting edits without a prior read will fail, requiring a read-then-edit sequence.

friction: First round of edits failed because the files had not been read before attempting edits, requiring a full read pass of all 6 files before the edits could be applied.
ci.yml required multiple edit passes due to its dual indentation patterns (standard jobs vs. reusable workflow call section), and one occurrence was missed in the first edit round.
The error message had already changed from a prior fix attempt, making it harder to diagnose whether the root cause was fully addressed without checking all workflow files.
open_items: An `npx pnpm approve-builds` step was referenced during the session but not found in the current workflow files — may have been part of a prior commit attempt that was not included in this fix and could still be needed.
ci-e2e.yml and codecov-base.yml were checked and confirmed clean, but were not deeply reviewed — worth a pass if CI issues persist.
